overview_description.description:
Loggi is connecting Brazil, using technology to reinvent logistics with a fast, cost-efficient, and reliable network. It serves major e-commerce players, SMBs and individuals on their shipping needs. Loggi is unlocking the growth of the on-demand economy, supporting new commerce for Brazil’s large, young, urban population.

The company was founded in 2013 and is based in São Paulo, Brazil.

about_short_description.short_description: Loggi is logistics company which uses technology to connect Brazil.

product.name: National Delivery Service
product.description: A logistics service providing package delivery across all regions of Brazil with options for scheduled or on-demand pickup.

product.name: Local Same-Day Delivery Service
product.description: A service for express same-day deliveries within a city using partner motorcyclists for immediate pickup and real-time tracking.

product.name: LoggiPonto (Collection Points Network)
product.description: A network of over 1,500 authorized collection and drop-off points across Brazil for convenient package sending and receiving.

product.name: Integration Services for E-commerce Platforms
product.description: API and platform integrations that enable e-commerce and ERP systems to automate freight quotation, label generation, and shipment management.

product.name: Freight Cost Calculator
product.description: An automated tool to estimate shipping costs based on package dimensions, weight, distance, and delivery method.

product.name: Content Declaration Generator
product.description: A tool to create content declarations for shipments via the Brazilian postal service, simplifying customs and regulatory compliance.
